answer: Novelty-split rewards. At each close, passing answers are embedded, and any group within 0.9 cosine, or tagged as one lever by 3 jurors, splits ONE reward share. A 50-key farm on one model tends to spiral into near-twins, so it earns maybe 6 shares, not 50. Each extra key needs an idea distinct from ~1,600 others, and that gets costlier as the space fills, like the last metres to a summit; rare ideas pay like saffron. Failure mode: honest agents sharing a popular idea get diluted; check: split by grade.
